### Calendar

- API: [Checkiday - National Holiday](https://apilayer.com/marketplace/checkiday-api)

  Description: Industry-leading holiday data with over 5,000 holidays and thousands of descriptions

  Auth: `apiKey`

  HTTPS: Yes

  CORS: Unknown
